profile.summary: Tilden Preparatory School is a private school for grades 6-12 with campuses in Albany and Walnut Creek, California. It offers one-to-one and small-group teaching of UC-approved courses, and is accredited by WASC. It is also approved as a Nonpublic School, which provides education and support for students with specialized learning needs.
